title: Supplier orders: selected customer profile, complete document workflow and receiving

task.name: Operate the selected supplier's complete order and fulfilment task
task.purpose: Deliver the supplier-facing order review, confirmation, dispatch and invoice workflow beside the partner's existing ERP, integration or procurement platform, with original source history and complete customer receiving.
task.request: Continue the original Workshare's selected supplier, legal entity, currency, interface mapping, source family, message corpus and HTTPS boundary. Receive complete original purchase orders and the agreed change/cancellation messages. Select a retained openTRANS 1.0 customer profile before first business intake; keep existing workspaces on their original profile. If the workshare includes another input family, implement only its actual supplied version/schema and corpus after the owner selects that contract. Map exact business/line references, quantity, price, tax, dates, parties and original full-versus-delta semantics. Save, review, prepare and deliberately select complete confirmation, dispatch and invoice documents. Send each reviewed document through the original declared channel against the same selected business revision; retain the actual provider response before advancing the workflow.
task.completeOutput: The complete supplier application and selected profile/mapping or agreed adapter; retained original and generated documents; exact order, quantity and commercial history; configured transport and original provider-response records; actual full receiving results; and a portable editable customer workspace. Deliver the complete source/runtime selection, configuration templates, operating/recovery guide, agreed review rounds and named-operator walkthrough. The recipient reopens and continues local work while retaining imported history and newer corrections.
task.repeatTrigger: A new original supplier order, a selected revised order, a fulfilment event or a reasoned local correction requires useful work. An uncertain send, repeated original request, interrupted download or earlier-package replay is reconciled with its original operation and retained history.
task.pricedUnit: If a separately commissioned merchant service is selected, define one complete supplier task and its agreed document/receiving boundary before setting an exact atomic price and whole-task budget. HTTP attempts and recovery remain linked to that original task. Preserve the proposed professional Workshare fee and milestones independently; they are not an atomic service price or evidence of a paid purchase.

source.reference: Select the actual supplier/partner message contract, complete original corpus, retained customer profile and declared transport agreement. Use the maintained supplier-order product, customer guide and full browser/CLI/MCP reference; record its installed source release and existing business workspace.
source.population: Every message and original business line in the contracted supplier/entity/currency corpus, including complete orders, agreed revisions/cancellations, partial confirmations, multiple dispatches and invoice references. Keep original source IDs separate from document IDs, order IDs, local revisions and provider delivery identities.
source.meaning: Preserve exact original identifiers and long/special order IDs, line references, decimal quantities/prices/tax, rounding policy, currency, units, parties, delivery periods, package/serial remarks and document revision semantics. The selected profile determines cancellation/completeness rules. A foreign input format requires its actual selected adapter; a profile declaration alone does not convert it.
source.changePolicy: The supplier and partner select the original profile, message mapping, format/version and provider contract. Preserve current business heads and drafts when importing history. A changed profile uses the maintained empty-workspace selection/adoption path. Extra source families, entities, currencies, protocols, output conversions or review scope follow the original Workshare change process.

receiving.application: The original supplier-order browser, installed CLI and typed/MCP consumer over one private workspace, plus the partner's actual ERP/BIS/shop boundary and configured HTTPS receiver. Keep private endpoint and credential references with the original host-owned channel declaration.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Run the complete agreed source corpus through review, saved drafts, XML preparation and explicit document selection; confirm exact quantities, money, source references and selected profile. Exercise the agreed inbound and outgoing HTTPS behavior, complete response retention and actual provider reconciliation of uncertain outcomes. Export the full workspace, inspect and explicitly adopt its profile into a separate empty customer workspace, retain later local draft/correction history, return the complete customer package and preserve that later work when an earlier package is replayed. Close the unchanged phase criteria and agreed review/walkthrough scope.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The partner retains its client relationship, ERP/BIS/shop configuration and financial-posting authority. The endpoint owner controls authentication, TLS, activation, acknowledgment and production approval. Operators choose declared channel IDs and reviewed hashes; URLs and secrets stay in host configuration. HTTP acknowledgment and customer business acceptance remain separate.
receiving.recovery: Read the original request and transmission before retrying. A completed request returns its retained outcome; an UNKNOWN send requires actual provider readback before an explicit eligible retry. Prepare transmissions against the selected current document/order revision. Retain full response bodies and exact XML hashes. Reopen the same private store after interruption and import complete packages through their original requests, preserving current local drafts and newer history.
receiving.maintenance: Name the supplier operator, partner integration owner, endpoint/credential owner, deployment maintainer, acceptance coordinator and receiving engineer. Retain actual runtime/source versions, certificate/access renewal, backup/reopen, monitoring and rollback instructions. Keep ongoing operations, licenses and additional support within their original agreed ownership and allowance.

steps.title: Bind the original scope and supplier contract
steps.result: Receive the full Workshare and quoted phase/effort/milestone source. Select the one actual supplier/entity/currency, profile, mapping, complete source corpus, return boundary and named partner/endpoint/acceptance owners.

steps.title: Select the profile and actual source adapter
steps.result: Use the maintained profile declaration and original empty-workspace selection. Preserve legacy workspaces and original publisher notices. Implement a foreign input adapter only when the original Workshare includes it and the partner supplies its complete real contract and corpus.

steps.title: Operate review and fulfilment
steps.result: Retain complete originals, map exact fields and expose actionable findings. Use the same browser/CLI/MCP workspace for complete saved drafts, XML preparation and deliberate selection of confirmation, dispatch and invoice revisions.

steps.title: Configure and receive the declared HTTPS exchange
steps.result: Use owner-managed channel, credential and TLS references. Retain an incoming original before its agreed acknowledgment. Prepare and send each selected outgoing document against its reviewed branch; capture complete provider responses and reconcile uncertainty before any deliberate retry.

steps.title: Run the complete contracted receiving corpus
steps.result: Exercise source revisions, cancellations, partial quantities, dispatch/invoice references, exact money and the agreed provider rejection/timeout/recovery cases. Retain complete outputs and apply the original consolidated review allowance.

steps.title: Receive and continue the complete customer package
steps.result: Export full source, profile, documents, selected history, drafts, transport and requests. Inspect and explicitly adopt the package on the named empty customer workspace, make a later local revision, reopen and preserve it through earlier-package replay and a complete return.

steps.title: Hand over the installed operating workflow
steps.result: Deliver exact versioned source/runtime, selected profile/mapping/adapter, configuration templates, original and generated files, full receiving results and operator guide. Complete the agreed walkthrough, deployment handoff and unchanged commercial acceptance criteria.

inputs: Original complete customer Workshare and receiving packet, source/case/sender identities, plan digest, exact effort mapping and proposed commercial milestones
One actual supplier/legal entity/currency and the agreed original corpus, message versions, extensions, identifiers, full/delta/cancellation semantics and acceptance outcomes
The selected openTRANS 1.0 customer profile and supplier-to-partner mapping; the complete actual foreign source contract only when that adapter is included
Original return-document boundary and any partner-owned ERP/BIS/shop conversion or financial posting responsibility
Declared inbound/outgoing HTTPS channels, profile hash, supplier identity, actual authentication/TLS/acknowledgment contract and approved test access
Complete maintained installed source/runtime selection and private existing supplier/customer workspace paths, with actual operator identities
Complete XML, package and response artifacts, original request IDs and agreed independent receiving/return/reopen criteria
Agreed review rounds, active start conditions, dependency pause rules, support and license ownership; separate atomic service terms only if explicitly selected
